neighbours.label: a list, not one pattern: pieces of the espresso drinks latte and cappuccino, and of lithium-ion; I could not find a shared pattern, so the label stays a list; plain coffee, tea, batteries and ions in other uses stay quiet
fire: My sister asked for a large latte and a muffin.
We shared a cappuccino on the terrace before the train.
Every morning he picks up a latte on the way to work.
The waiter set down two cappuccinos and a glass of water.
This drill runs on a lithium-ion pack that charges in an hour.
Engineers improved the lithium-ion cells in the new scooter.
Her camera takes a small lithium ion cell from the same maker.
Early lithium-ion packs lost their charge within a few years.
quiet: My sister asked for a large tea and a muffin.
We shared a pizza on the terrace before the train.
Every morning he picks up a newspaper on the way to work.
The waiter set down two black coffees and a glass of water.
This drill runs on a power cord that plugs in at the wall.
Engineers improved the brake pads in the new scooter.
Her camera takes a small memory card from the same maker.
Early sodium ions moved across the membrane within a few seconds.
